The '''Lust system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the group known as the [[Lost Sultans of Lust]].<ref name="GPBTG" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lust system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square J-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
